inbox.title: My tasks
inbox.intro: Each task comes from the engine's latest decision: evidence your side still owes, approval roles not complete, an open dispute, an unauthorised event, or your turn to sign. Once done, the engine re-evaluates and the task goes away.
inbox.footer: Other parties' tasks are not shown here; the contract page shows the full status.
inbox.searchPlaceholder: Search contract code, title or milestone ID

detail.noMilestones: No milestones yet. They are created when the digitised terms are locked.

requirement.UNAUTHORIZED: Unauthorised event {{id}}; the {{side}} resubmits and controllers handle it (BR-19)

payment.title: Payment overview
payment.progressAria: Eligible and penalty share of the contract value

history.body: Events and every status change by the engine, newest first (up to 200 rows).

signing.title: Signing order ({{signed}}/{{total}} signed)
signing.note: Signers and their order are seed data (the Data Pack only has the CONTRACT_SIGNED event). When the last one signs, the buyer's CONTRACT_SIGNED event is recorded.
signing.none: This contract has no signing order.

decision.transferred: Simulated payment recorded; the milestone is now Payment transferred.

payment.title: {{amount}} million VND transferred by {{by}} at {{at}}
payment.body: Idempotency key {{id}}: one payment per milestone and decision version. The milestone is final; new events are only recorded.

amounts.title: Amounts
amounts.noDue: Unreadable due date: held under rule 80
amounts.noPenalty: No late penalty on this milestone
amounts.note: The engine computes with Decimal, never floats. Eligible is not the amount paid.

events.title_one: {{count}} event of the milestone and how the engine classified it
events.title_other: {{count}} events of the milestone and how the engine classified them

history.title: Status history
history.note: Every evaluation has a run id; the same data and version always give the same result.

exceptions.title: BR-19 exceptions
exceptions.body: Only unauthorised or anomalous events can be voided. One controller proposes, a second approves; the original event is never edited or deleted, and voiding never creates evidence.
exceptions.reason: Reason (required), e.g. the supplier used the wrong channel and the buyer resubmitted
exceptions.proposed: Proposal sent; a second controller decides.
exceptions.demoReason: Demo reason: ask another controller to review event authority and related evidence under BR-19.

dispute.title: Disagree with the decision?
dispute.body: The buyer or the supplier opens a dispute; the milestone is held (rule 10) until the buyer closes it validly.

replay.title: History, event by event
replay.body: The engine re-evaluates the milestone right after each of its events, using only the data known at that moment (as-of mode, BR-16). Use it to explain how the milestone reached its current decision.
replay.empty: The milestone has no events yet.
replay.error: The replay failed. Try again later.
replay.note: Before the due date, a milestone still missing evidence shows as Planned or In progress. Replaying writes nothing.

submit.title: Submit evidence · Milestone {{no}} · {{name}}
submit.nothingLeft: Your side has submitted everything for this milestone.
submit.lockNote: Each file becomes an event in the Data Pack schema; it cannot be edited or deleted after submission.

aftermath.title: After you submit
aftermath.validate: Authority check against matrix 4.2 and deduplication (BR-03, BR-04).
aftermath.match: The Python engine runs the 8 rules in priority order and computes the amounts.
aftermath.result: Decision, status history and audit are recorded.
aftermath.noApproval: none; the contract releases automatically when conditions are met

preview.title: If you submit now (engine dry run)
preview.empty: Attach the documents to see the expected result.

penalty.title: Penalty terms
penalty.terms: Due {{due}}, {{grace}} days grace (until {{deadline}}). After that {{rate}}%/day, at most {{cap}}% of the milestone value, from the actual completion date.
penalty.none: This milestone has no late penalty.

file.otherUnauthorized: A copy was created by a party without authority; the {{side}} must submit a valid one.
file.replacesUnauthorized: A valid copy; the old unauthorised event keeps the milestone on hold until controllers void it (BR-19).
file.unauthorizedMine: an unauthorised copy exists; submit a valid one

approve.title: Payment approval · Milestone {{no}} · {{name}}
approve.requested: Request recorded; the milestone keeps waiting.

blocked.MILESTONE_CLOSED: The milestone is final; no more decisions.
blocked.NOT_APPROVER: You are not an approver of this contract's buyer; view only.
blocked.APPROVAL_NOT_REQUIRED: This milestone needs no approval (automatic policy).
blocked.NOT_REQUIRED_ROLE: Your role is not one of the milestone's required roles; you may still reject with grounds.
blocked.ALREADY_APPROVED: You already approved; each person counts once (BR-10).

proposal.title: Result if you approve
proposal.preview_one: Engine dry run with your approval: {{decision}} · {{reason}} · {{count}} day late.
proposal.preview_other: Engine dry run with your approval: {{decision}} · {{reason}} · {{count}} days late.

documents.title: Valid evidence
documents.missing: No valid evidence yet; the {{side}} must submit it.
documents.note: An approval does not replace missing evidence: the milestone is eligible only with both the evidence and the approval roles.

consequences.title: What each choice does
consequences.approve: Approve: records an APPROVAL event; the engine re-evaluates at once.
consequences.requestInfo: Request info: a note to the parties, no event; the milestone keeps waiting.
consequences.reject: Reject: records a REJECTION event; the milestone becomes REJECT (rule 20) and cannot be undone in the system.

note.label: Note
note.hint: required to reject or request info
note.placeholder: Explain the decision or requested documents (up to 2,000 characters).
note.demo: Demo note: check evidence, amount and payment conditions before submitting a decision.

confirm.title: Confirm approval
confirm.body: Record your approval of milestone {{no}} · {{name}}. Expected: {{decision}}, eligible {{payable}} million VND.
